$comment: Source-pixel spec (1536x1024 → 12x8; the airlock and the slide-room doorway come out ~32-38 px) — the HIVR containment corridor on the night of the breach (story 3.3, ADR-138): the top wall band (airlock, clipboard, the rain window, the glove station) and the slide room's back wall with its hood, bench and fridge are `buildings`; the glass partition is walls either side of its open doorway; the stool and the fridge are blocks; the bottom wall band with the handrail. You enter at the airlock as Ravi; the call comes as you cross the corridor's middle (a band you cannot walk around); the glove station refuses; the tray is under the hood. 4.3c (ADR-154): `airlock_back`. 4.5 (ADR-157): Ravi in the corridor, Meera behind the lab glass (inside the lab's walls — seen, not reached).
